papers.headline: A Multidimensional General-Relativistic Boltzmann Solver for Neutrino Transport: Implementation, Discretization and Optimization
papers.summary: We present the implementation of a multidimensional general-relativistic Boltzmann solver for neutrino transport using the finite volume method. We extend the general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics solver ttGmunu to discretize the full 6D phase space.
papers.title: A Multidimensional General-Relativistic Boltzmann Solver for Neutrino Transport: Implementation, Discretization and Optimization

papers.headline: Inclination of Miranda as a Constraint on the Tidal Dissipation of Uranus
papers.summary: The five major moons of Uranus record a complicated geological history characterized by both tectonic resurfacing and heavy impact cratering, connecting their evolution to dynamical processes in the Solar System.
papers.title: Inclination of Miranda as a Constraint on the Tidal Dissipation of Uranus

papers.headline: A Comprehensive Study of the Magnetic White Dwarfs in DESI DR1
papers.summary: As the end point of stellar evolution for most stars, white dwarfs offer powerful insight into stellar magnetism.
papers.title: A Comprehensive Study of the Magnetic White Dwarfs in DESI DR1
